name: Product crew
description: Finds the stories that are not ready, rewrites them with testable acceptance criteria, and proposes how to split the large ones.

briefing.jql: project = {{project}} AND statusCategory = "To Do" AND issuetype not in subTaskIssueTypes() ORDER BY priority DESC, created DESC
